$comment: Checks in jdk-differential.test.ts that fail today, each tied to the roadmap issue (#3) that should fix it.
Listed checks run as it.fails(): the suite stays green, and turns red when a fix makes one pass. Delete the entry then.
"issues": what the failure is waiting on, main issue first. "reason": the symptom, in a few words.
See the details of any case with: npx tsx scripts/java-diff.ts <case id>

collections/coll-arrays-aslist-fixed.reason: Arrays.asList(...).add() succeeds instead of throwing UnsupportedOperationException

collections/coll-arrays-tostring-objects.reason: Arrays.toString ignores the elements' toString() (prints P@1)

collections/coll-char-keys.reason: HashMap<Character, Integer> prints in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-concurrent-mod.reason: removing from a list inside its for-each throws no ConcurrentModificationException

collections/coll-fqn-scanner.reason: new java.util.Scanner(...) creates an object of class 'java'

collections/coll-hashmap-order-strings.reason: HashMap iterates in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-hashset-order-ints.reason: HashSet iterates in insertion order, not Java's hash order

collections/coll-list-equals.reason: List.equals compares identity instead of elements

collections/coll-list-of-immutable.reason: List.of(...).add() succeeds instead of throwing UnsupportedOperationException

collections/coll-list-of-user-objects-pr.reason: an explicit list.toString() ignores the elements' toString()

collections/coll-list-remove-object-vs-i.reason: list.remove(Integer.valueOf(40)) removes by index instead of by value

collections/coll-list-set-index.reason: list.set() past the end grows the list instead of throwing IndexOutOfBoundsException

collections/coll-map-computeIfAbsent.reason: Map.computeIfAbsent with a lambda is unsupported (Unknown method)

collections/coll-map-merge.reason: Map.merge with Integer::sum fails (Variable 'Integer' is not defined)

collections/coll-priorityqueue-comparato.reason: PriorityQueue ignores its lambda comparator (natural order, no error)

collections/coll-priorityqueue-print-ord.reason: PriorityQueue prints fully sorted instead of in Java's heap-array order

collections/coll-queue-remove-noarg.reason: queue.remove() with no argument crashes with a JavaScript TypeError

collections/coll-scanner-input-mismatch.reason: Scanner.nextInt() on "abc" returns 0 instead of throwing InputMismatchException

collections/coll-sort-comparator-lambda.reason: List.sort ignores its lambda comparator; Collections.reverseOrder() is unsupported

collections/coll-word-count.reason: HashMap prints in insertion order, not Java's hash order

core/boxed-methods.reason: methods on boxed values (Integer.compareTo, Double.intValue) are unsupported
